beats.summary: Michael tries to recruit a cheerleader for the basketball game, with Pam refusing and Phyllis volunteering.

evidence.snippet: Pam: I don't think so Michael. Besides, I can't cheer against my fiance.

beats.summary: Michael and Darryl make a bet on the basketball game with stakes involving dinner and working on Saturday.

evidence.snippet: Darryl: Why don't we make it more interesting? Loser buys dinner at Farley's.

beats.summary: The basketball game begins with team assignments and some trash talk between players.

evidence.snippet: Michael: OK, Ryan, you have Darryl. I have Roy.
Roy: Don't listen to him Pam. Trust me, tip it my way or you're sleeping in the car.

beats.summary: Michael struggles with his basketball performance, missing shots and expressing frustration.

evidence.snippet: Michael (misses a half court shot): Aw, come on! What is wrong with me today!?
Michael (misses another shot): What is wrong with me today?!

beats.summary: Michael reflects on basketball as a way to relieve work stress and questions his identity during the game.

evidence.snippet: Michael: When I am playing hoops all of the stress and responsibility of my job here just melts away.
Michael: Who am I? Am I Michael Scott? I don't know… I might just be a basketball machine.

beats.summary: The game continues with competitive plays, including Darryl scoring and Michael calling a timeout to motivate the team.

evidence.snippet: Darryl (scores): Here we go. Here we go. Here we go.
Michael: All right, time, time out. Come on, sales, over here. Bring it in! Come on!
